title: SpotOn Chooses AiPrise for Identity Verification
summary: SpotOn, which provides restaurant technology and payments for restaurants across the US, has selected AiPrise as an identity verification provider.
body_markdown:
[SpotOn](https://www.spoton.com/?utm_source=aiprise&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=aiprise_case_study) , which provides restaurant technology and payments for restaurants across the US, has selected AiPrise as an identity verification provider. AiPrise helps SpotOn confirm the identity of the people behind the businesses it serves.


## Why SpotOn Chose AiPrise


Providing software and payments to restaurants means onboarding business owners at scale and knowing exactly who is behind them. That verification has to be accurate without slowing a new restaurant down.


AiPrise confirms the identity of the people behind each business, checking them against government sources and screening them against global watchlists, in one flow. For SpotOn, that means confidence about who is behind its restaurant partners before they start taking payments.


> "Our restaurant partners want to be up and running fast, and we need to be certain who we're working with to keep their accounts secure from day one. AiPrise lets us do both without adding friction to onboarding."
> Lisa Lechner, Chief Compliance Officer, SpotOn


Restaurants run on busy days and thin margins, and the tools behind them need to keep up. SpotOn is building the software and payments that keep restaurants running, and being able to quickly verify each one is part of what makes that possible. We are glad to be part of that.


Welcome to AiPrise, SpotOn.


## About SpotOn


SpotOn provides software and payments for restaurants across the US. Learn more at[spoton.com](https://www.spoton.com/?utm_source=aiprise&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=aiprise_case_study) .


## About AiPrise


AiPrise is the AI-powered global compliance platform: KYB, KYC, AML screening and AI agents in a single API, across 200+ countries.
